independence_rules.rule: Two source IDs are independent only when their publisher orgs differ. Same-org pairs (e.g., OWASP-ASVS-V11 vs OWASP-CHEAT-CS) are NOT independent.
independence_rules.memory_alignment_note: M9: AI prior knowledge consistent with a fetched source is NOT a second corroborating observation. Memory and source share a common upstream (training data + fetched document may both derive from the same root). Memory alignment is recorded in M8 verification summaries but never counted toward M5 corroboration.
